findings.text: EXIT_CODE is uninitialized when version is already installed; the test [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ] fails with empty variable, blocking default package installation even when SKIP_DEFAULT_PACKAGES is not set.
The condition [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ] inverts the logic for reinstall-packages, causing it to run only when the previous npm upgrade failed instead of on success.
The condition [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ] before nvm alias inverts the logic, setting the alias only when previous commands failed instead of on success.
return $EXIT_CODE returns an uninitialized/empty value when no prior branch set EXIT_CODE, instead of returning the actual exit status of the last operation.
